name: Website Sitemap Fetcher
description: Fetches and parses a website's sitemap XML to extract all page URLs

url.description: The base URL of the website to fetch the sitemap for (e.g., https://example.com)

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for each HTTP request in milliseconds

userAgent.description: User agent string to use for HTTP requests

maxUrls.description: Stop processing after finding this many URLs

pageUrls.label: Page URLs
pageUrls.description: List of deduplicated page URLs extracted from the sitemap(s)

warnings.label: Warnings
warnings.description: List of warnings encountered during sitemap processing

errors.label: Errors
errors.description: List of errors encountered during sitemap processing

error.label: Error Message
error.description: Error message if the operation failed
